_doc: CORS for the M1.4 subscriptions HTTP API (API Gateway HTTP API CorsConfiguration).
b3_allow_origins: the intended production list for the B3 route change set. It is explicit:
never '*' (M1's flight-m1-subscribe-api currently uses '*', which B3 replaces).
The owner confirms the production origin before B3. Vercel preview origins are deliberately
absent: previews never call the production API (Phase 3B decision A).
local_allow_origins: what aws/tools/local_api.py allows by default (Vite dev and preview).
Used by aws/tools/local_api.py and checked by aws/tests/test_m14_local_harness.py.
